name: Faustina Yarathingal
summary: Faustina Yarathingal is a full-stack developer and forensic-science student in Mumbai. She designs, builds, and ships complete web and mobile applications — product UI, realtime systems, and AI-assisted tools — and brings a forensic habit of checking evidence before drawing conclusions. She is studying B.Sc. (Hons.) Data Science and AI at IIT Guwahati and completed a diploma in Forensic Science and Criminal Law at St. Xavier's College.

projects.name: Dossier
projects.description: This assistant. A GPT-style portfolio chatbot: unlimited answers about Faustina from a structured source, plus capped general questions through Groq. Chats persist in the browser. No visitor sign-in.

projects.name: Inkroom

projects.name: FocusFlow

projects.name: Atmo
